translation.about_text: Prime Care is a leading supplier of advanced medical equipment and laboratory solutions. We partner with global brands to provide hospitals and clinics with the reliable diagnostic and analytical tools they need to deliver exceptional care.
translation.srv_devices_desc: The latest diagnostic and therapeutic equipment from the best global brands.
translation.srv_reagents_desc: High-quality medical and laboratory reagents for all clinical applications.
translation.srv_lab_desc: Equipping medical laboratories with advanced analytical devices.
translation.srv_consumables_desc: Various supplies including surgical tools, protection, and sterilization materials.
translation.srv_maintenance_desc: Periodic maintenance and specialized technical support to ensure equipment continuity.
translation.srv_training_desc: Specialized training programs for medical staff on equipment usage.
translation.services_subtitle: We provide a wide range of medical products and solutions to meet the needs of healthcare facilities.
translation.partners_subtitle: We take pride in our wide network of global agencies and local clients
translation.contact_subtitle: Get in touch with our team today
translation.contact_desc: Our support team is available 24/7 to assist you.
translation.location_desc: Yemen, Sana'a, 60th Street, Al-Awlaqi Laboratories Building
translation.testim_subtitle: We take pride in the trust of our successful partners in leading hospitals and laboratories.
translation.testim_1_text: Prime Care has proven its immense capability in equipping our laboratories with the latest technologies and best medical devices. We always trust their products, expertise, and rapid response in engineering support and periodic maintenance.
translation.testim_2_text: We are proud of our continuous partnership with Prime Care. They present complete commitment to the highest quality standards in supplying medical and diagnostic consumables, positively impacting the services we provide to our patients.
translation.testim_3_text: One of the best local companies we've worked with in hospital equipment. They stand out with high professionalism and provide immediate, reliable technical support continuously.
translation.testim_4_text: Our partnership with Prime Care has been a quantum leap in our hospital's medical equipment. Punctuality, device quality, and an integrated engineering team working with professionalism and dedication.
